note: Curated launch-window commercial signals. Each item cites its source; 'confirmed' = company filing or first-party, 'reported' = third-party estimate. Implied figures are GTAVI.AI arithmetic on the cited numbers, labelled as such.

sensor-tower.label: Sensor Tower via Rockstar Intel / GamesIndustry.biz

ttwo-q1-fy27.label: Take-Two Q1 FY27 earnings release (8-K, Aug 7, 2026)

kotaku-paris.label: Kotaku — Paris banner censors the guns

preorders.scope: US digital only — excludes boxed copies and all non-US markets
preorders.vs_record: +148% vs Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2022), the previous pre-order record, over the same 149→45 days-before-launch window
preorders.caveat: $630M ÷ 6.45M ≈ $98 per copy, above the $79.99 Standard price even though Sensor Tower says Ultimate ($99.99) sells less than Standard — treat the revenue estimate as soft; the unit count is the firmer number.

guidance.implied_note: GTAVI.AI arithmetic: FY guidance − Q1 actual − Q2 guidance = what Take-Two expects from Oct 2026 – Mar 2027, the GTA VI launch window.

signals.title: New long-term Xbox publisher licence
signals.detail: Take-Two and Microsoft signed a new XBOX Publisher License Agreement (effective Sep 17) replacing all earlier Xbox agreements — wholesale price / revenue share on digital sales, Microsoft approval rights on games and marketing.

signals.title: First TV ad is a broadcast-safe cut
signals.detail: The Launch Trailer's TV edit drops the shower scenes — mainstream broadcast reach over fidelity to the online cut.

signals.title: Market-specific creative
signals.detail: A giant Paris billboard removes every gun from the key art — Rockstar is localising out-of-home creative to local ad standards.

signals.title: Retail and hardware pull-through
signals.detail: IGN and Best Buy run three weeks of giveaways to launch, and PlayStation discounts refurbished PS5 bundles ahead of GTA VI.

signals.title: Game Awards eligible by one day
signals.detail: The Nov 19 release clears The Game Awards 2026 eligibility cut-off by a single day.

signals.title: 2.56M UK workers expected off on launch day
signals.detail: Uswitch extrapolates from a 1,000-person sample of gaming-affine employees — colour, not data.
